question: Among our top 10 paying customers, can you identify the largest change in payment amounts from one month to the immediately following month? Specifically, please determine for which customer and during which month this maximum month-over-month difference occurred, and provide the difference rounded to two decimal places.
sql:
-- Final query with proper month formatting
WITH top10 AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(p.amount) as total_paid
    FROM payment p
    JOIN customer c ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
    ORDER BY total_paid DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
monthly_payments AS (
    SELECT p.customer_id, date_trunc('month', p.payment_date) as payment_month, SUM(p.amount) as monthly_total
    FROM payment p
    WHERE p.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM top10)
    GROUP BY p.customer_id, date_trunc('month', p.payment_date)
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT customer_id, payment_month, monthly_total,
           LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) as prev_month_total,
           LAG(payment_month) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) as prev_month
    FROM monthly_payments
),
consecutive AS (
    SELECT customer_id, prev_month, payment_month, monthly_total, prev_month_total,
           ROUND(monthly_total - prev_month_total, 2) as month_over_month_diff
    FROM with_prev
    WHERE prev_month_total IS NOT NULL
      AND payment_month = prev_month + INTERVAL '1' MONTH
)
SELECT cu.customer_id,
       cu.first_name || ' ' || cu.last_name as customer_name,
       CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cp.payment_month) AS VARCHAR) || '-' || 
       LPAD(CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM cp.payment_month) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') as month,
       cp.month_over_month_diff
FROM consecutive cp
JOIN customer cu ON cp.customer_id = cu.customer_id
ORDER BY cp.month_over_month_diff DESC
LIMIT 1
